title: Portfolio Choice under General Utility with Transaction Costs and Search Frictions
abstract: arXiv:2610.00998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study finite-horizon portfolio optimization with proportional transaction costs and trading opportunities arriving at the jump times of a Cox process. Borrowing and short-selling are prohibited, while utility functions need not be concave, increasing, or differentiable. The admissible class includes differentiable utilities with asymptotic elasticity greater than or equal to one. The associated Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation is semi-linear and nonlocal, with control entering only through a zeroth-order term. We show that the normalized equation admits a unique bounded solution that is continuous in all state variables and classical in time and log-price. The proof combines a contraction argument with interior Schauder estimates, and verification identifies the value function and yields an optimal Markovian feedback strategy. translated_title: 一般效用函数下含交易成本与搜索摩擦的投资组合选择
translated_abstract: 我们研究了带有比例交易成本、且交易机会在Cox过程跳跃时刻到达的有限期限投资组合优化问题。借贷和卖空均被禁止，而效用函数不必是凹的、递增的或可微的。可容许的效用类包括渐近弹性大于或等于1的可微效用。相应的Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman方程是半线性且非局部的，控制仅通过零阶项进入方程。我们证明了归一化后的方程存在唯一的有界解，该解在所有状态变量上连续，且在时间和对数价格上是经典解。证明方法结合了压缩映射论证与内部Schauder估计，通过验证定理识别出价值函数，并给出了最优的马尔可夫反馈策略。非凹效用下的数值例子显示，在固定时间和交易前财富水平处会出现多个区间……
tldr: 本文研究了在比例交易成本与Cox过程搜索摩擦下、允许一般（甚至非凹、非递增）效用函数的有限期限投资组合优化问题，证明了相应半线性非局部HJB方程唯一有界连续经典解的存在性，并由此构造出最优马尔可夫反馈交易策略。
en_tdlr: This paper solves finite-horizon portfolio optimization with proportional transaction costs and search frictions (Cox-process trading times) under general, possibly non-concave utility, proving a unique bounded continuous classical solution to the associated semi-linear nonlocal HJB equation and deriving an optimal Markovian feedback trading strategy.
